children: BTIG reiterated their Buy rating on McGraw Hill's stock with a price target of $17.00.
The price target implies an upside of 28.2% from the Sep 21 close of $13.26.
Key takeaways from the analyst note
Strong Market Position and Product Innovation

: McGraw Hill has demonstrated its strength in the K-12 and Higher Education markets, consistently gaining market share and providing innovative products that enhance learning outcomes. Their advancements in AI-driven tools and curriculum solutions position them ahead of competitors, driving both retention and new revenue opportunities.
Positive Financial Outlook and Growth Catalysts

: The company's transformation into a digital-first business has resulted in a higher mix of recurring revenue, with projections of mid-single-digit digital growth and robust Adjusted EBITDA margins. Upcoming growth catalysts, such as a multi-year K-12 upcycle and increased penetration in the Inclusive Access market, further support a favorable financial trajectory.
